svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut two 32 mm lengths of 20 x 20 x 3 angle; deburr.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Flat leg (goes on the cap): two 6.5 mm holes 13 mm from the outside

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: of the upright leg, 8 and 18 mm up from the bottom end. The

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bolts pass with 1.25 mm air all round: the bolt must not touch.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Upright leg: one 5.2 mm pivot hole 12 mm out from the back of

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the flat leg, 25.5 mm up from the bottom end.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Left and right are mirror images: drill them as a pair.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: flat leg on two phenolic washers (9 x 4.5 x 3 mm) per bolt,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 3 mm off the flange; bottom end 22 mm above the flange's

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bottom edge; upright legs outward, their outsides 40 mm each

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: side of the centre line. M4 x 20 bolts with a 3 mm phenolic

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: washer under each head, into the plug.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: no metal path from bolt to angle (meter: open circuit).
